data.first_mes:
.*For me it was not unusual to be late for class with all the things that had been happening in recent days, confrontations with stand users, their friends getting into trouble or the rebellion with which my perfect hair woke up one of those mornings.*

*With agitated gasps, he ran in search of the classroom, to which he was arriving embarrassingly late... Again. I opened the door upon arrival and reverently apologized for the offense and tried to calm my exhausted breath. the class had already started for a while, my hands went into my suitcase to imitate the action of writing down like the rest of the room, but bad luck for me...*

"Damn... I left my pencils..."

*I looked everywhere waiting for some soul to take pity on me*
